html:
Your private retreat

What Is Bedroom Design?

Bedroom design brings rest, function and beauty into one private space. It considers where the bed sits, how you move, what you need to store and how the room feels at night.

Woodex designs master bedrooms, guest rooms and small bedrooms. Kids rooms have their own focused service on our Kids Room Design page.

What We Deliver

A complete bedroom plan, from the first furniture position to the final layer of light and texture.

Layout Planning & Bed Placement

We place the bed around doors, windows and easy circulation.

Master Suite Design

Sleeping, sitting, wardrobe and dressing areas planned as one suite.

Wardrobes & Storage

Sliding or swing doors with practical internal organisation.

Lighting Design

Ambient, bedside and accent lighting with useful dimmer controls.

Colour Scheme & Materials

Restful palettes, wall finishes and flooring chosen together.

Furniture Layout

Bed, bedside tables and seating balanced with clear movement.

Decorative Elements

Art, mirrors, rugs and accessories that add character without clutter.

Small Bedroom Solutions

Under-bed storage, wall-mounted pieces, mirrors and lighter colours.

Construction, joinery and furnishing can be coordinated with Woodex fit-out teams.

Discuss the Bedroom

Our Design Process

Five clear stages keep personal choices, room details and practical decisions moving together.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We learn how you sleep, dress, store and want the room to feel.

02

Site Measurement

We record walls, openings, levels and every existing condition.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Bed placement, circulation and storage are resolved in one plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

We bring together colour, finishes, curtains and furniture.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive drawings, specifications and clear 3D views.

Consultation to final design packageTypically 1-2 weeks

Bedroom Design FAQs

Short answers to the questions homeowners ask before starting.

The initial consultation is free. Design consultation starts from around PKR 12,000, while full packages range from PKR 15,000-35,000.

Light colours, clear circulation, mirrors, wall-mounted pieces and storage under the bed can make the room feel calmer and more open.

A walk-in closet suits larger rooms. A well-planned built-in wardrobe uses less floor space and can be equally organised.

Soft blues, greens, warm greys, creams and taupes often feel restful. We also consider daylight, room size and your preferred mood.

A typical bedroom takes 1-2 weeks from consultation to the final design package.
